```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
titanic_data = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set the style for seaborn
sns.set(style='whitegrid')

# Create a figure for the visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

# Create a countplot to show the number of survivors and non-survivors based on the passenger class
sns.countplot(data=titanic_data, x='pclass', hue='survived', palette='Set2')

# Set plot title and labels
plt.title('Survival Counts by Passenger Class', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)

# Customize the legend
plt.legend(title='Survived', loc='upper right', labels=['No', 'Yes'])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
